profiles.description: Use generated masks, region briefs, and site briefs as controlled inputs for Ganglia Studio asset production.
Let the coding agent choose available local/image-generation tooling and integrate produced assets directly.

assetKinds.description: World-scale backdrop with sea on both sides, continuous isthmus countryside, river, terrain texture, and town/canal geometry registered to the app canvas.
Painted full-town background that follows the generated land, canal, district, and sign masks.
One precise mask per district, generated from layout polygons.
Global town masks for the land footprint, canal centerline ROI, canal section, canal banks, shoreline wall, and generated district-wall layer.
Transparent bespoke structure sprite for a project site.
Transparent raster sprite sheet for mop workers with walk, sweep, idle, and bucket-carry cycles; generated from the animation manifest frame contract.
Declarative animation data for sprite sheets, frame timing, and route assignment.
